sql:
SELECT sc.class AS bj, sc.score, sc.exam_score, sch.s_name AS school_name
FROM tb_score sc
JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
WHERE e.exam_name = '2026届高三1月期末'
  AND e.subject = '数学'
  AND sc.subject_name = '数学'
  AND sch.s_name LIKE '%扬州中学%'
  AND sc.score > 0

sql:
SELECT
  sch.s_name AS xx,
  sc.class AS bj,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  AVG(sc.score) FILTER (WHERE sc.score > 0) AS avg_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 90.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_n,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 90.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pass_rate
FROM tb_score sc
JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
WHERE e.exam_name = '2026届高三1月期末'
  AND e.subject = '数学'
  AND sc.subject_name = '数学'
  AND sch.s_name LIKE '%扬州中学%'
  AND sc.score > 0
GROUP BY sch.s_name, sc.class
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
